candidate_passages.text: The 2025 EuroHPC programme update recommends deploying two exascale systems, tightening federation and middleware links among HPC, AI and quantum infrastructure, and preparing post-exascale architectures. It says application impact rather than TOP500 position alone should guide infrastructure metrics.
candidate_passages.candidate_claim: Public research-computing programs are integrating accelerator compute with data, network and application infrastructure rather than treating compute rank as the sole outcome.
